title: Persona Profile Retire — payload
description: Stop being a face everywhere, and keep it. The face is taken off every persona wearing it, left out of pickers and default listings, and cannot be worn until reinstated; its values and its disclosure history are kept. The reversible middle between 'not here' (a null persona/binding/set) and 'gone' (persona/profile/delete).

profileId.description: A pool face, or a context-local one.

contextId.description: The context a context-local face lives in. Omit for a pool face.

Response.title: Persona Profile Retire — response payload
Response.description: Success response to persona/profile/retire. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/persona/profile/retire/1.0#response. Retiring a face already retired is a success that changes nothing and takes no new version, so a repeated retire converges.

unbound.description: Where the face was worn and no longer is. Absent when it was worn nowhere.
